name: bubble
title: Bubble
description: Manga-styled wrapper around your shadcn Bubble (conversation): speech bubbles with a 2px ink line and a tail at the bottom pointing at the speaker; only the last bubble of a group keeps its tail; new bubbles pop in. default is an ink bubble (your messages), secondary / muted / outline / tinted are paper bubbles, destructive adds the accent and a "!" mark.
docs: Import from "@/components/ui/manga/bubble". It wraps your own components/ui/bubble, so Radix and Base UI both work.

meta.usage:
import { Bubble, BubbleContent, BubbleGroup } from "@/components/ui/manga/bubble"

<BubbleGroup>
  <Bubble variant="secondary"><BubbleContent>Did you read it?</BubbleContent></Bubble>
  <Bubble align="end"><BubbleContent>Twice.</BubbleContent></Bubble>
</BubbleGroup>
